questions.question: Clarify the statements about al-Khwarizmi’s role at the House of Wisdom and the novelty claimed for his account of Indian numerals.

localizations.source: Clarify the statements about al-Khwarizmi’s role at the House of Wisdom and the novelty claimed for his account of Indian numerals.
localizations.ru: Уточнить формулировки о роли аль-Хорезми в «Доме Мудрости» и о новизне его изложения индийской записи чисел.

questions.resolution: The text now states only that al-Khwarizmi worked at the House of Wisdom and that his book described Indian numeral notation; unsupported priority and administrative-title claims were removed.

questions.question: Verify the wording about heading the House of Wisdom’s library and the first explanation of Indian numerals; confirm the portrait’s and book illustration’s provenance and the basis for reproducing all three archival images.

localizations.source: Verify the wording about heading the House of Wisdom’s library and the first explanation of Indian numerals; confirm the portrait’s and book illustration’s provenance and the basis for reproducing all three archival images.
localizations.ru: Уточнить формулировки о руководстве библиотекой «Дома Мудрости» и первом объяснении индийской записи чисел; подтвердить происхождение портрета и книжной иллюстрации и основание воспроизведения трёх архивных изображений.
